description.zh:
如果调用超时，选择是否继续运行SQL语句，取值如下：

- **true**：继续运行
- **false**：停止运行

> 默认情况下，SQL语句在调用超时后停止运行。
description.en:
Specifies whether to continue running the SQL statement if the call times out. Valid values:

- **true**: Continue running.
- **false**: Stop running.

> By default, the SQL statement stops running after the call times out.

description.zh:
是否将结果集格式化为单个JSON字符串。

- 仅允许传入**NONE**或**JSON**。
- 默认值为**NONE**。
- 此参数仅适用于SELECT语句，对于其他类型的语句将被忽略。
- 结果将返回在**formattedRecords**中。
description.en:
Specifies whether to format the result set as a single JSON string.

- Only **NONE** or **JSON** can be specified.
- Default value: **NONE**.
- This parameter applies only to SELECT statements and is ignored for other types of statements.
- The result is returned in **formattedRecords**.

description.zh:
是否在结果中包含元数据的值，取值如下：

- **true**：包含
- **false**：不包含
description.en:
Specifies whether to include metadata in the result. Valid values:

- **true**: Include metadata.
- **false**: Do not include metadata.

description.zh: 待执行SQL语句的参数详情。
description.en: The details of the parameters for the SQL statement to execute.

description.zh:
用于指向用户希望访问的资源，格式如下：```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

参数说明如下：

- regionId：地域ID，可调用[DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~)接口获取。
- accountId：阿里云账号ID，可调用[DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~)接口获取。
- instanceId：实例ID。
description.en:
The resource ARN that points to the resource that the user wants to access. Format: ```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

Parameter description:

- regionId: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~) operation to obtain this value.
- accountId: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can call the [DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~) operation to obtain this value.
- instanceId: The instance ID.

description.zh: 控制如何返回结果集的选项。
description.en: The options that control how the result set is returned.

description.zh: Data API账号的用户凭证，您可调用[DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~)接口获取该参数的值。格式如下：`acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`
description.en: The user credential of the Data API account. You can call the [DescribeSecrets](~~446624~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter. Format: `acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`.

description.zh: 已启动的事务ID，您可调用[BeginTransaction](~~446897~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the transaction that has been started. You can call the [BeginTransaction](~~446897~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

descriptions.zh: 本接口当前仅支持华东1（杭州）、华北2（北京）地域的Serverless实例使用。
descriptions.en: This operation is supported only for Serverless instances in the China (Hangzhou) and China (Beijing) regions.
